name: nimble-shred-migrate-tools
description: Mac-migration pack/restore tooling for Nimble Shred. Deliberately isolated here (its own package.json + node_modules under scripts/, not repo root) so Vercel's zero-config build detection for the deployed static site never sees it — a root-level package.json risked Vercel auto-running an install/build step that doesn't exist today (Build Command: none, per _spec_workflow.md).
